newsitem.title: USA: Air BP, Conoco enter jet fuel pact.
newsitem.headline: Air BP, Conoco enter jet fuel pact.

text.p: Air BP Americas, a division of British Petroleum, and DuPont's Conoco Inc said on Friday that they have entered into an agreement for the supply and sale of avaiation fuels in the U.S.

Air BP will assume Conoco's General Aviation marketing activities located in the Midcontinent and Rocky Mountain regions, and Conoco will supply jet fuels to Air BP under a long term supply agreement, the firms said.
Conoco will continue to market jet fuel to commercial airlines and the military.
Conoco said it entered in the agreement as a way to improve its offering to their branded Aviation Fuels customers.

"Conoco has determined that the best way forward is to enter into a long-term supply agreement with a company that has robust marketing support programs which will compliment Conoco's refining and distribution strengths in aviation fuels," the company said in a statement.
